extension.displayName: Git Commit Message Generator - LLM API
extension.description: Generate Git commit messages with the VS Code Language Model API
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Generating a commit message reads repository changes, runs Git, and sends the filtered diff to the selected language model.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: The extension requires a file-system-backed Git repository.
configuration.title: Git Commit Generator
configuration.language.description: Commit message language. 'auto' detects the language from the VS Code locale.
configuration.useGitmojis: Include Gitmoji emoji prefixes in commit messages.
configuration.includeBody: Generate a detailed body for complex changes.
configuration.bodyThreshold: Minimum number of changed files required to generate a body.
configuration.recentCommitsCount: Number of recent commits to include as context.
configuration.excludeFiles: Glob patterns for files excluded from the diff sent to the model. Supports **, *, and ?.
configuration.modelFamily: Preferred language model family. The model picker sets this value automatically.
